name: delve-die-repeat
description: Delve, Die, Repeat — offline Android roguelike dungeon-crawler. Engine extracted from the mazeworld.html prototype.

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:www && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run cap:sync && node tools/pin-jdk.mjs && node tools/gradle.mjs assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run cap:sync && node tools/pin-jdk.mjs && node tools/gradle.mjs bundleRelease
scripts.play:release: npm run version:bump && npm run android:release
